items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: Mark Martin Warno liked it... And I played along the whole thing... Mark Martin Warno said, 'that's fine.'

ctx.x: so that he knew what George Washington Hill wanted, and this is what it was.

So I remember one time going in there, and I got this -- pretty much the same effect, at least Mark Martin Warno liked it, in strings. It was a beautiful tune, I forget the name of it now, but so many of them were in those days.

And I played along the whole thing. I didn't have a brass figure in the whole first chorus, but it sounded full, because I had the strings in the proper register, and everything was full. I had the saxophones and the strings and all, and it sounded -- in the control room it sounded like the brass was playing, as far as that was concerned. It was filled up strata-wise, up here, here, down here.
